messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Paytm
Ishkabir kumar
ishkabir... that's a name that commands respect. where you working these days?
paytm... the fintech that went from hero to zero faster than a upi transaction. found you on linkedin - Senior Software Engineer at Paytm. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/ishkabir-kumar
Yes

senior software engineer at paytm... building the tech that powers india's digital payments while watching the stock price do gymnastics. respect for sticking with it through the ups and downs. what's keeping you busy in the engineering trenches there?
Nothing much, that’s why I’m looking for a switch

ah, the classic "nothing much" syndrome... when you're too good for the work they're giving you but too comfortable to leave. paytm's probably got you maintaining legacy code while the interesting stuff goes to the "core team." how long you been working total?

"good pay and good company culture with peace of mind"... translation: you're tired of paytm's chaos and want somewhere that won't have you questioning your life choices every monday morning. fair enough. 

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Open to all places if the brand in one the biggest in the world

ah, the prestige chase... "biggest brands in the world" means you want that google/microsoft/amazon flex on your resume. i get it. nobody's impressed when you say paytm anymore.

so let me get this straight: 3 years experience + senior software engineer + open to anywhere for the right global brand + wants good pay and peace of mind... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

legend! you're officially in the tal system now. 

from paytm's payment chaos to the big leagues... that's the energy we need. those google cloud certs aren't just pretty certificates anymore - they're about to pay dividends.

welcome to the game, ishkabir. time to get you somewhere that actually deserves your skills.

Thanks

Thanks

Hi
Hello

hey ishkabir

how you feeling today?
I want to quit my current job
that's a big move. what's making you want to leave paytm right now?

My manager is shot
  *shit
ah, the classic toxic manager situation. that'll do it. what's he doing that's making it unbearable?

He’s an idiot
  No tech
  Nothing to learn from him

that's the worst kind of manager - the one who can't even teach you anything. stuck with someone who doesn't know tech but still gets to call the shots.

how long you been dealing with this?
Nothing
wait what do you mean nothing? like you just started or...

hey, paypal's hiring senior fullstack engineers in bangalore

they want 5+ years but your senior title at paytm might bridge that gap

hybrid setup - 3 days office, 2 days flexible
